title: Word Within a Word · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word Within a Word · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose and write a familiar word of at least five letters. The lead identifies a shorter familiar word appearing as consecutive letters inside it. The group confirms the shorter word appears in order inside the original. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word Within a Word, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group confirms the shorter word appears in order inside the original.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group confirms the shorter word appears in order inside the original.
